data.description: Brandon, 11 Oct, asked about keeping design docs in a private repo beside public ones (he's formalizing his orchestrator elsewhere). Recommended: split by audience. Private companion repo (sibling checkout, added to agents' working dirs; no submodule): process and decision notes, docs/plans, docs/branding.md, the full model-bench lab notes, the design hand-off sources, handoffs, and the ledger. Public: code, README, LICENSE, building and settings docs, the site, brand assets the app and site use, the bench CSVs the results page reads, and a timeless ARCHITECTURE.md for contributors distilled from DESIGN.md. Timing: decide before the repo goes public, because flipping it publishes every commit and every pushed branch (origin/tuhdoo holds the ledger). Simplest safe path: publish a fresh one-commit history.
data.title: Decide: move internal docs (DESIGN.md process notes, plans, branding, research notes, design hand-off, the tuhdoo ledger branch) to a private companion repo before EasyVox goes public
